description.value: Kernels Popcorn is a 100% Canadian-owned franchise founded in 1983 in Toronto, specializing in flavored popcorn sold through mall retail locations across Canada. The chain offers a wide range of gluten-free, whole-grain popcorn flavors and operates a loyalty perks card program. If a location exists in North Vancouver, it would serve as a quick snack stop for cyclists passing through a mall corridor.
